note: Do not edit by hand — run `npm run fixtures:generate`.

tones.name: sine-1k
tones.description: 1 kHz sine, -6 dBFS — single known peak at an exact level

tones.name: chord-a-major
tones.description: A3 major triad (220 / 277.18 / 329.63 Hz) — three simultaneous peaks

tones.name: harmonic-e2
tones.description: E2 (82.41 Hz) with 12 harmonics — instrument-like line spectrum

tones.name: square-500
tones.description: 500 Hz band-limited square — odd harmonics only, no aliasing

tones.name: sweep-log-20-20k
tones.description: Exponential sweep 20 Hz to 20 kHz over 2 s — equal energy per octave

tones.name: sweep-linear-100-8k
tones.description: Linear sweep 100 Hz to 8 kHz over 2 s — equal energy per Hz

tones.name: white-noise
tones.description: Flat stationary noise, 2 s — every bin excited, no quiet moments

tones.name: pink-noise
tones.description: Pink noise (-3 dB/octave), 2 s — real level in the low bands

tones.name: white-noise-eq
tones.description: white-noise through targetCurveDb — the reference take for an exact match

tones.name: cab-noise
tones.description: Pink noise through a guitar-cab curve, 4 s — band-limited program material

tones.name: cab-noise-eq
tones.description: cab-noise plus targetCurveDb — the reference take for the cab-noise pair

tones.name: cab-noise-44100
tones.description: Cab + target curve at 44.1 kHz — a reference take whose bins sit at different frequencies from the working take, so matching by bin index would skew the whole curve

tones.name: mixed-program
tones.description: Note-shaped cab noise plus a quiet pink bed and a 110 Hz harmonic line, 4 s — non-stationary, so the noise-floor estimator has quiet moments to measure

tones.name: mixed-program-eq
tones.description: mixed-program through targetCurveDb — reference take on realistic material

tones.name: mixed-program-quiet-hiss
tones.description: mixed-program with a -65 dBFS hiss floor added

tones.name: mixed-program-loud-hiss
tones.description: The same program material as mixed-program-quiet-hiss, sample for sample, but 23 dB hissier (-42 dBFS). Only the noise floor differs, so the honest tone match between the two is flat and any correction is the gate failing.

tones.name: impulse
tones.description: Single full-scale sample then silence — flat spectrum, convolution identity

tones.name: clipped-1k
tones.description: 1 kHz sine driven 12 dB into a hard clip — broadband and badly behaved

tones.name: silence
tones.description: All zeros — nothing downstream may divide by it

tones.name: dc-offset
tones.description: Constant +0.5 — energy only in the DC bin

tones.name: nyquist
tones.description: Alternating +/- 0.9 — energy only at Nyquist

tones.name: sine-1k-24bit
tones.description: 1 kHz sine at 24-bit — parser depth coverage

tones.name: sine-1k-32bit
tones.description: 1 kHz sine at 32-bit — parser depth coverage

tones.name: sine-stereo
tones.description: 1 kHz left / 440 Hz right — the mono mix must be the average of the two, not one channel
